test_title: PYST 6: SSC JE CE- General Intelligence (Held On 10 Oct 2023 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question:
Three statements are given followed by three conclusions numbered I, II and III. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

No cat is a dog.

All dogs are rats.

Some bears are cats.

**Conclusions:**

I. All rats can never be cats.

II. No bear is a rat.

III. All bears can never be dogs.
solution:
The least possible venn diagram is shown below,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f684336ed6d0e1e16c79b4b04bc93b8d107f482b2d68b17dde1fba77611ddd3.png] 

Conclusions:

I. All rats can never be cats → **Follows** (Because some rats are dogs, and no dogs are cat)

II. No bear is a rat → **Not Follows** (Because it is possible but not definite)

III. All bears can never be dogs → **Follows** (Because some bears are cat, and no cats are dogs).

Hence, the correct answer is **"****Only I and III follow"**.
